decks.notes: Utilize Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast artifacts from the graveyard, generating infinite mana with Mox Amber and Grinding Station. Use Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig for combo pieces and Thassa's Oracle as a win condition. Urza's Saga can search for key artifacts like Mox Opal or Mishra's Bauble. Control the opponent's board with Malevolent Rumble and Lightning Bolt while disrupting their spells with Spell Pierce and Swan Song. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and protect it until victory is achieved.

The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo using Underworld Breach in combination with various artifacts and spells to generate infinite loops. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station play key roles in this strategy, with support from cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan as much as possible. With careful planning and execution, the deck can win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main idea of this deck is to use cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Mox Opal, and Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard and create a loop that can lead to a game-winning combo. The deck also includes cards like Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble to help facilitate this combo. By utilizing these cards effectively, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful sequence of plays that can quickly bring the game to a close.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies combined with disruptive elements to control the opponent's game plan. It aims to apply pressure through efficient creatures while also disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus. The deck leverages the Death and Taxes archetype's ability to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan while maintaining a clock with aggressive creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Ketramose, the New Dawn. The deck's synergy between its creatures and disruptive elements allow it to outpace and control the opponent in a 1 vs 1 match.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, backed up by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off opponents. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and utility. The deck also includes cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm for disruption and protection. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Flooded Strand to ensure consistent access to the needed colors. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and swiftly close out games.

This deck focuses on assembling pieces to enable a powerful combo involving Underworld Breach, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and various artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck aims to create an overwhelming advantage through card advantage and board presence. Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble provide additional utility and synergy with the combo pieces, giving the deck multiple paths to victory. Overall, the key strategy revolves around rapidly assembling and executing the combo to overwhelm opponents and secure a win.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies combined with disruption and graveyard hate. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude while using creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes cards like Relic of Progenitus to disrupt opponent's graveyard strategies. With a mix of aggro creatures, disruptive spells, and graveyard hate, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent's defenses and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects to repeatedly blink them in and out of play, gaining value each time. The combination of aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk, along with blink spells like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, allows for rapid board presence and disruption. By combining aggressive strategy with blinking effects, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent while maintaining control of the battlefield. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Prismatic Ending and Relic of Progenitus provides additional removal and disruption options to further support the aggro-blink archetype.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponents' spells, removing threats from the board, and drawing cards to maintain card advantage. It also utilizes the companion mechanic to provide additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, stall the game until it can establish a dominant position with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, and ultimately win through incremental advantage and resource management. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy and ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for its powerful spells.

The key concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw while maintaining control of the board through powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. The deck aims to control the game tempo, slowly wearing down the opponent's resources before deploying game-winning threats. By utilizing a mix of disruptive spells and versatile creatures, the Dimir Control deck seeks to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent in a battle of attrition.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to cast spells from the graveyard, enabling a powerful combo with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill through the deck and win through alternate win conditions like Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes a variety of cheap artifacts and efficient spells to fuel the combo and protect the key pieces. By assembling the necessary cards and executing the combo efficiently, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through strategic play and careful resource management.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressively pressuring opponents with a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells. By curving out efficiently with early threats like Ragavan and Seasoned Pyromancer, the deck quickly puts pressure on the opponent. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury can provide a huge burst of damage and Goblin Bombardment adds reach. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ranger-Captain of Eos provides additional utility and card advantage to maintain pressure throughout the game. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and resilient aggressive strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. Utilizing cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment for additional removal options and damage output. With a mix of creatures, spells, and support cards, this deck aims to maintain board control while dealing consistent damage to the opponent, ultimately securing a quick victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Landless Combo archetype to quickly assemble a powerful combination of cards and abilities that allow for a win condition without the need for traditional mana sources. By utilizing cards like Fallaji Archaeologist, Hydroelectric Specimen, and Goblin Charbelcher, along with disruptive spells and card draw options, the deck aims to control the game state and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and abilities. The focus is on quick, efficient plays and outmaneuvering the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Yawgmoth, Thran Physician's ability to sacrifice creatures for various effects while also using creatures like Delighted Halfling and Endurance to create a toolbox of options. Chord of Calling allows for searching for specific creatures, while Dredger's Insight helps with card advantage. The deck also includes creature removal options like Walking Ballista and Orcish Bowmasters. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Underground Mortuary for added utility. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently control the board and assemble its combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures using Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, while also utilizing noncreature spells like Ancient Stirrings and Kozilek's Command to control the board. The combo aspect comes from cards like Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief, which can generate massive amounts of value when combined with other cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats and disruptive plays, ultimately leading to a game-winning board state.
